evidence.text: Phonosemantic compound. 虫 represents the meaning and 延 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *l'aːns): phonetic 延 (OC *lan, *lans) + semantic 虫 (“snake, insect”) – "egg", with particular reference to snake eggs.
The non-contracted form is 蜑. In the current version, 延 is abbreviated to 疋.
This character was coined at a late stage in Chinese, since it is unattested on oracle bones, bronzes, Shuowen Jiezi and Guangyun.
From 彈 (MC danH, “pellet”) (Zhengzhang, 2003).
